category_title: Students who actively distance themselves from non-reading family environments
student_description: Demetrius is a polite, highly motivated student who consistently struggles in traditional English classes that rely on whole-class assigned texts due to a lack of early reading models at home. He uniquely requires complete autonomy in text selection, personalized goal-setting, and a supportive reading community to build his identity as a successful reader.

criteria.rationale: Demetrius shuts down academically when forced to read whole-class texts but thrives when given the agency to choose his own reading material.
criteria.check: The tutor explicitly allows, encourages, or provides options for Demetrius to choose his own reading material rather than enforcing a pre-assigned or uniform text.

criteria.rationale: Because he lacks early reading models, Demetrius needs to build his reading identity through taking ownership of his own goals and reflections.
criteria.check: The tutor prompts Demetrius to set a personal reading goal, log his progress, or reflect on his own effort for the current session.
